Order on memo of petition:-
The present petition has bee filed with the following prayers:-
"A writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the competent Authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer, Gorakhpur to pay the remaining amount Ram Nakshatra And Another vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60615006/
1 of compensation Rs.10,35,000/- towards 3 dismil land acquired for National Highway-19, which has not been paid to the petitioners so far."

entities.text: Ram Nakshatra And Another vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In various paragraphs of the writ petition, the petitioners submit that the recovery initiated against the petitioners pursuant to an inquiry made by the competent authority was illegal, inasmuch as, 24 decimal of land of the plot-in-question had been sold by the father of the petitioner to one Sri Ravindra Singh vide sale-deed dated 08.04.1992.
The contention is that only 3 decimal of land had been acquired from the remaining share of the father of the petitioner wherein the names of the petitioners have been mutated.

Due to fraudulent act of the vendor namely Sri Ravindra Singh, false report was submitted by the competent authority which led to the recovery of compensation paid to the petitioners for the acquired land.
Noticing the said contention made in the writ petition, we may record that co-owner of the land-in-question namely Ravindra Singh is not a party to the writ petition.
A Writ Petition No.13802 of 2022 was filed by the petitioner challenging the recovery certificate dated 12.04.2022 issued by the Tehsildar, Bansgaon, Gorakhpur along with other prayers made therein.

A perusal of the judgment and order dated 18.08.2022 indicates that the writ petition has been dismissed with the observation that the Court did not find any merit in the challenge to the impugned recovery certificate.
In the said scenario, no mandamus can be issued.
On the submission of the counsel for the petitioner, that recall application has been filed, it would be open for the petitioner to press the same before the competent authority.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
